cite_locations.context: This theorem is a completion corollary of established inhabitation complexity; it is not a new PSPACE result for STLC. Its role is to make the semantic boundary precise. M\"undler, He, Wang, Sen, Song, and Vechev already connect type-constrained generation to inhabitation and use a sound search with an explicit incompleteness tradeoff~\cite{types}. ChopChop treats semantic decoding via realizability~\cite{chopchop}. Neither reference licenses a claim that all typed prefixes have the complexity of context-free syntax.
